_comment: Named looks for materials/HandStringVisualizer.fs. Each value is keyed by the shader input NAME; the matching OSC address comes from the "parameters" section of addresses.json.

chill.description: Slow, warm sunset colors; a lazy pull and soft glow. Good for ambient or downtempo.

rave.description: Full rainbow cycling fast, hard bass kicks and a thick, bright string. For high-energy drops.

neon.description: Magenta and cyan club neon, strong glow, steady pull.

ice.description: Cool blues and whites, gentle motion, thin crisp string. Calm or cinematic moments.

heartbeat.description: Barely moves on its own; every bass hit yanks the string. Best on tracks with a clear kick.

minimal.description: Dark background, no aurora, a single pale string. Lets the hand and string carry the scene.
